ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between high-intensity white interior regions (RGB ~210-245) and low-intensity black perimeter borders (RGB ~15-40).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on distal lobe surfaces; thick black pigmentation bands (50-100 pixel width) along the trailing edges; isolated circular black pixel cluster located in the mid-section of the left lobe white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes varying from 5 to 15 pixels along the visible posterior boundary; jagged profile clearly delineated against water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the trailing edge sweeping upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-relief pixel clusters with brownish-grey intensity localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-intensity dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the distal white field of the right lobe, approximately 30-50 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent epibiotic accretions on both fluke tips; circular dark pigmentation mark on the left lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique curved black linear mark on the far right distal white field, distinct from edge pigmentation.
